specimens.name: AC servo motor with rear encoder housing
specimens.notes: Compact finned servo motor with flange, output shaft and distinct rear feedback/connector housing; no cable or surrounding machine.

specimens.name: Servo motor with inline planetary gearbox
specimens.notes: Servo motor is visibly coupled coaxially to a compact planetary reducer with a single output shaft.

specimens.name: Servo motor with right-angle gear reducer
specimens.notes: Motor and serviceable gearbox form a compact offset/right-angle reduction package with a distinct output shaft, not an external drivetrain.

specimens.name: Motorized ballscrew linear actuator
specimens.notes: Short servo-driven linear actuator visibly includes motor, screw/rail housing, carriage and end support; no larger frame.

specimens.name: Electric rotary actuator with integrated brake
specimens.notes: Compact rotary drive combines motor, reduction body, brake-like rear/mid can and one front output flange as one module.

specimens.name: Direct-drive torque-motor rotary module
specimens.notes: Low-profile annular rotary module has a large central bore, precision mounting ring and integrated side feedback housing; no complete turntable.

specimens.name: Brushless spindle/drive motor with resolver housing
specimens.notes: Late-1990s brushless motor shows machined front flange, short shaft, finned body and rear resolver/feedback housing without fan shroud or cable.

specimens.name: Electrohydraulic servo cylinder with position-transducer body
specimens.notes: Precision cylinder shows polished rod/clevis ends, integrated servo-valve block and separate linear position-transducer body; no hoses or manifold network.

review_method: Exact untouched PNG visually inspected against the merged E2 machine spec, style bible and E2 era contract; dimensions, byte count and SHA-256 verified locally; Google Drive readback matched the exact byte count and SHA-256 before acceptance.
